description: An inline box paints its own background and border behind each line it occupies, with its near edges on the first and last of them. Port-authored: the reference engine paints per-run colour, size, weight and decoration only, so an inline background has no reference behaviour to port.
visual_assertions: Both chips are drawn as rounded pale-blue pills with a thin border, each wider than its text by its padding.
The two chips are separate pills: the word between them is on the white page, not on a chip.
The highlighted phrase is drawn in yellow on each of the three lines it occupies, and no line is a closed box: the left edge is on the first line only and the right edge on the last.
Nothing is painted behind the undecorated span.
